source_ref: NASA Earth Observatory, World of Change: Amazon Deforestation; https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/world-of-change/amazon-deforestation/ ; published display JPGs, exploratory RGB upload test, not drone imagery
coordinate_note: Approximate regional reference near Buritis, Rondonia, supplied only because application requires coordinates. NOT image center, footprint or surveyed position. Do not use for area or distance.
time_note: Source supplies calendar dates only; midnight UTC is a serialization placeholder, not a known acquisition time.
alignment_note: Same published viewport, 720x480. Visual landmark consistency; four 50x50 high-pass patch searches within +/-6 pixels peaked at dx=dy=0 (correlations 0.575,0.300,0.360,0.095). Exploratory pixel correspondence only; not surveyed, georeferenced or subpixel-validated coregistration. No resampling applied.
mask_note: Manual conservative spatial subset: x=40..599,y=140..344 inclusive; exclude x=500..599,y=250..310. White=retained for exploratory use, black=excluded. Avoids visible labels, scale bar, obvious edge cloud/smoke areas. NOT an authoritative cloud/clear classification; residual haze and other artifacts may remain.
validation_scope: Real historical satellite display images; functional RGB import/screening test only. No calibrated reflectance, NDVI, ground truth, detection accuracy or deforestation area validation.
